cases.name: device-representative-execution-with-bound-receipt
cases.dependency: No reachable approval surface exists for local.skill.script on the installed Desktop: the chat consent card filters to local.files.write (platform_chat.py _consents) and the tray decision surface is not attached in desktop mode. The settings-rule bypass would execute but stamp basis "policy", which the Server receipt archive refuses for completed skill receipts (receipt_archive.py), poisoning the session. Covered at runtime-test level per the Desktop report; recorded here as unexecuted+dependency.

cases.name: changed-script-bytes-reauthorization-on-server
cases.dependency: No real surface republishes different script bytes into the same frozen resource (skill-draft carries script members forward; re-import collides on slug). The device leg covers byte drift with SKILL_SCRIPT_CONTENT_MISMATCH (T122-01) and the unit suite covers the server-side category.

cases.name: authorization-card-list-and-empty-state
cases.dependency: The mount-time list IPC raced the runtime-restart window (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE/timeout family) and the Alert replaced the honest empty-state text inside the driver window. The registry itself is honestly empty: the direct list returns zero authorizations (asserted) and the runtime snapshot carries skillScriptAuthorizations: [].
